answer: Split-site liveness challenge: an identity passes only by completing the same random nonce at two verifier terminals separated by a canyon with no route shorter than the challenge window. Each terminal mixes a locally captured horizon image into the nonce. A light pulse through an opal diffuser is hashed too, so the nonce cannot be precomputed. An attacker pays one independent custodian physically present at the far terminal per identity, plus failed attempts; a single operator cannot be in both places at once.
